title: US strikes hit Iran for seventh consecutive night
original_summary: Iran has retaliated against US allies in the region, with Kuwait reporting that a power and water plant had been hit.

original_title: Iran War Updates: Bridges and Water Plants Hit as Strikes Stretch to 7th Straight Day
title: Iran War Updates: Bridges and Water Plants Hit as Strikes Stretch to 7th Straight Day
original_summary: Overnight and into Friday, Iran reported U.S. strikes on infrastructure that can serve civilian purposes and has targeted similar sites in Gulf countries that host American bases. In the afternoon, the U.S. military announced a new round of attacks on Iran.
